sentences.text: The evidence does not state a gold-loan pre-payment penalty amount or rate.

The in-force UCB directions say that, for loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, pre-payment charges are governed by those directions, and for term loans any charge, if levied, is based on the amount being prepaid.

The bank’s in-force home-loan agreement states a 2% pre-payment charge, while a second in-force copy of the same clause states 3%, but those clauses are about home loans and do not establish the gold-loan charge.

missing.searched: Searched the gold-loan FAQ and the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions for a gold-loan-specific pre-payment charge; no gold-loan amount or rate was found.
